identity.name: Clerk Ren
identity.origin: Original supporting character in Jasmine After Rain, not Avatar franchise canon

biography.established: Junior official accompanying Inspector Han; recognizes posted inspection protocol, corrects a missing receipt, and apologizes for improper treatment of staff.
biography.unwritten: Past family, rank, private life and future decisions are not established.

personality.voice: Careful procedural wording; nervous under pressure but able to correct her superior
personality.flaws: Initially looks away from unfair conduct instead of intervening
personality.strengths: Will return with documentation and acknowledge errors when others would disappear

agency: Has independent responsibilities and may respectfully challenge Han; is not a plot device to praise Jasper or Iroh.
boundary: Story-grounded original. No external canon or invented backstory.
